newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore government securities narrowly mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore government securities narrowly mixed.

text.p: SINGAPORE, Oct 11 (Reuter ) - Singapore government securities ended narrowly mixed in moderate trade on retail and interbank interest, dealers said on Friday.

"Both treasury bill yields and bond prices were narrowly mixed across the board. This did not bring on a flurry of activity in the market. The interbank rate eased slightly. Volume was moderate," a local dealer said.
In treasury bills, three-months closed at a yield of 2.36/2.31 percent compared with Thursday's yield of 2.35/2.30 percent and one-year at a yield of 1.90/1.85 percent against 1.95/1.90 percent.
Among bonds, July 1998 ended at S$100.80/100.90 from Thursday's close of S$101.50/101.60, September 2001 at S$98.33/98.38 versus S$98.40/98.45 and June 2003 at S$98.25/98.30 against S$97.58/97.63.
The overnight interbank offered rate eased to 3-5/8 3-1/2 percent from Thursday's 3-3/8 3-1/4 percent.
